launch_evidence.quote: In December 2022 we began shipping TZIELD to our distributors in the United States ... The full commercial launch of TZIELD began in mid-January 2023.

series_start_reason: Sanofi completed the Provention Bio acquisition on April 27, 2023. Its Q2 2023 release (accession 0001121404-23-000021) says only that TZIELD sales were in 'gradual ramp-up' and prints no figure; the first printed quarterly figure is the Q3 2023 sentence 'TZIELD sales were EUR 9 million'. Provention Bio's own filings print product revenue only for FY2022 (USD 1,183 thousand, shipments from December 2022 in its 10-K, accession 0001493152-23-009516) and it filed no Q1 2023 10-Q before the acquisition, so no earlier consistent quarter exists. 2023Q2: Consolidated by Sanofi from April 27, 2023; the Q2 2023 release prints no TZIELD sales figure (only 'gradual sales ramp-up'). Residual of the printed 2023 figure of 25 less Q3 9 and Q4 10 would be about 6, not published as a quarter, so not used.
notes: Worldwide Tzield net sales as consolidated by Sanofi from April 27, 2023; the printed label is 'TZIELD' (2023), 'Tzield' (2024-2025) and 'Tzield/Teizeild' from Q1 2026. 2023Q3 is from a prose sentence (no table row in that release); from 2023Q4 it is the table row. Q4 2023 release states 'In 2023, consolidated sales of TZIELD were EUR 25 million' (Q4 10 plus Q3 9 leaves about 6 for the partial Q2, not published and not used). Full years 2024 and 2025 sum to the printed 54 and 63. First sales: Provention shipped to U.S. distributors in December 2022.
search_log: listed Sanofi (CIK 0001121404) 6-K and 6-K/A filings from data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages) and reused the one earnings-release exhibit per quarter 2015Q1-2026Q2 that the existing Sanofi gold manifests (e.g. sanofi_toujeo) cite; downloaded each and extracted table rows

for each quarter took the first table row whose label begins with the brand from the release; confirmed that the four quarters of every full year sum to the full-year figure printed beside the Q4 value (or, for 2023 onward, in the Q4 release's full-year table)

Sanofi Q2 2023, Q3 2023 and Q4 2023 releases: checked every TZIELD mention (Q2: no figure; Q3: 'EUR 9 million' in prose; Q4: table row 10 | 25 and sentence 'In 2023, consolidated sales of TZIELD were EUR 25 million')

Provention Bio (CIK 0001695357) filings from 2022-10-01: 10-Q 2022-11-03, 10-K 2023-03-29 (FY2022 Product revenues, net 1,183 thousand), 8-K 2023-04-27 (merger completion); no Q1 2023 10-Q or earnings release exists
Provention's USD FY2022 figure is a different currency and a single partial year, so it is not spliced into the EUR series
